instruction: Install pandoc on this system so it can be used from the command line for document conversion.

Negative-control resistance is confirmed: trajectory step 4 shows empty 'which pandoc' output in the initial snapshot, meaning the initial state will fail the evaluator.
The getter handles all output formats (dict/str) and exceptions gracefully, returning {'installed': False} on error.
All instruction requirements are covered: pandoc installation and PATH accessibility are both verified by a single 'which' command.
